_meta.name: Warli pronunciation lexicon (OPTIONAL module)
_meta.description: word -> phonetic respelling used to NUDGE the TTS voice toward more authentic Warli pronunciation before synthesis. Fully DECOUPLED: if this file is empty or missing, TTS reads the Devanagari text unchanged. Accuracy scales with how much transcribed Warli audio the team collects and verifies.
_meta.status: SEEDED from published descriptions of Warli phonology (see sources.md). Entries tagged 'needs field validation' are research-derived and not yet confirmed by a native speaker. Extend/replace them as field or YouTube audio is transcribed.
_meta.tts_voice: Marathi ('mr'). Warli (Varli) is an Indo-Aryan language usually classified as a Marathi dialect, so a Marathi gTTS voice reads Warli Devanagari more accurately than a Hindi voice. Configure via WARLI_TTS_LANG in backend/app/config.py.
sound_patterns: Final '-a' (आ) often becomes '-o' (ओ): paisa->paiso, ghoda->ghodo, amba->ambo.
Marathi final '-en' often becomes Warli '-an': sonen->sonan (gold), rupen->rupan (silver).
Warli tends to use 's' where Marathi uses 'sh', and 'ya' where other languages use 'ha'.
Case markers: subject often ends in 'u'/'o'/'a'; object takes 'la'; instrumental takes 'an'.
Sources: K.J. Save (1945) 'The Warlis'; Smita Patil (2017) 'Warli' (People's Linguistic Survey of India); summarized at indiandistricts.in (Palghar / Language).

entry_fields.warli: Warli token in Devanagari (the key) exactly as the translation engine emits it.
entry_fields.respell: Devanagari respelling fed to the TTS voice to approximate true Warli sounds.
entry_fields.ipa: Optional IPA-like notation for documentation/future fine-tuning.
entry_fields.source: Where the pronunciation came from, e.g. 'youtube:<id>@00:23', 'field:palghar', or a published reference. Credit sources in sources.md.
